title: The Love Hypothesis
author: Ali Hazelwood
summary: A PhD student invents a boyfriend to convince her best friend she is over a crush, then grabs the nearest man to prove it. He turns out to be a feared young professor in her own department, and the pretence gets complicated fast.
readIf: you want a warm, funny academic romance with a grumpy hero and plenty of lab-bench banter.
skipIf: you prefer your romances low on contrivance or find science-workplace settings a bit too cute.

pairings.reason: Another banter-heavy romance built on a tense workplace rivalry, with the same sharp, funny rhythm.
Also a smart, bookish rom-com with a prickly leading man, though it has a little more emotional weight.
Another romance starring a brilliant, socially uncertain lead who learns about love through a very structured arrangement.
